args.title: July 2023 analysis ownership card
args.body:
# July 2023 analysis ownership card

**Scope:** July 2023 only. These assignments were a temporary July working split, not a current standing org rule.

- **Helio Start baseline analysis:** Owen — default owner for the first-pass baseline readout shape and candidate field-completeness analysis.
- **Retained-mid expansion eligibility analysis (Expansion Assist):** Owen — default owner for eligibility and measurement cuts.

These were distinct lanes: Helio Start remained guarded pre-discovery, while retained-mid expansion work was exploratory measurement and not a Helio Start proof point or forecast item.
